outcome: Rate of cesarean delivery for the second twin
cohort: 269 sets of twins booked at a Hong Kong regional obstetrics unit over a 3-year period
finding: Increasing the rate of vaginal twin delivery did not significantly increase neonatal/maternal morbidities, except for a higher rate of low cord blood pH in the second twin during vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Significantly more women opted for vaginal delivery when deemed suitable, and while the success rate of vaginal delivery and need for cesarean delivery for the second twin remained similar, there were more cases of low cord blood pH in the second twin with vaginal delivery.
